items.title: OpenAI named a Leader in enterprise coding agents by Gartner
items.summary: OpenAI is named a leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents, with Codex recognized for innovation and enterprise-scale deployment.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI在Gartner发布的2026年企业级AI编码智能体魔力象限（Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents）中被评为领导者，其Codex产品因创新能力和企业级规模化部署表现受到认可。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI入选Gartner企业级AI编码智能体魔力象限领导者，标志着大模型编程Agent在企业落地的成熟度获得权威认可。

items.title: How Virgin Atlantic ships faster with Codex
items.summary: How Virgin Atlantic used Codex to ship its revamped mobile app on a fixed holiday travel deadline, reaching near-total unit test coverage and zero P1 defects.
items.summaryZh: 维珍航空利用OpenAI的Codex在紧凑的假日出行截止日期前成功发布了重构后的移动端应用程序，实现了接近全覆盖的单元测试率和零P1级软件缺陷。原始信息显示：How Virgin Atlantic used Codex to ship its revamped mobile app on a fixed holiday travel deadline, reaching near-total unit test coverage and zero P1 defects.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How Virgin Atlantic ships faster with Codex”。其重要性主要体现在：维珍航空通过应用Codex成功在紧迫截止日期前完成移动端重构，展示了LLM编程助手在真实企业工程中的效能。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
